title: Purchase Option
description: One way to buy a variant: once, or as a subscription. The Business lists the options it sells; the Platform selects one by `id`.

title.description: Short label distinguishing this option from its siblings (e.g. 'One-time', 'Subscribe & save 15%').

description.description: Supplementary buyer-facing context for the title, describing the way of buying (e.g. 'A fresh bag every month, 15% off'). Terms belong to the policy and amounts to `schedules`.

price.description: What one unit costs in the current purchase under this option, before quantity, taxes, fees, and fulfillment. `0` means genuinely free. Recurring orders are stated in `schedules`.

list_price.description: Reference price this option's `price` is a saving against, for strikethrough display. Absent when there is nothing to compare.

schedules.description: The recurring orders that follow the current purchase, as consecutive schedules in the order they take effect. Present only on an option that results in recurring orders; binding once selected on a cart or checkout line.
